content:
olivia: Heads up — we've seen a big spike in SLO alerts for /embed-service (≈120 alerts in the last hour) coming from one tenant. Can we discuss routing + quota behavior and a console UX to reduce noise? cc @jonathan @maya

jonathan: Is this the per-tenant burst quota we shipped last month? I noticed one tenant doing aggressive batch retries against the same route.

olivia: Likely both. The retries amplify matches and the console currently shows every match in the notify preview (no sampling). That overwhelms oncall and hides real regressions.

kevin: Proposal: implement soft-fanout for notify. When tenant crosses a notify-quota threshold, switch to a condensed async alert that aggregates duplicates and includes top examples. Keep immediate p99 alerts for owning SLOs only.

maya: UX idea: add a "noise" toggle next to each SLO in the console (on by default). It would explain why alerts are suppressed, show suppressed count, and allow expanding to see raw hits. Also show an example condensed alert.

sarah: Rollout question: how do we canary this safely? I'd like a tiered rollout: 5% of tenants -> 20% -> 100%, and an opt-out toggle for tenants with compliance needs. We also need a telemetry flag to flip back quickly.

jonathan: Backend note — we'll need a small API addition to notify routing. Sketch: 
```json
{
  "policy_type": "soft_fanout",
  "tenant_quota": 1000,
  "condensed_alert_window_sec": 600,
  "sample_rate": 0.1
}
```
This would be per-tenant, per-route.

olivia: Draft route policy snippet (for console -> API):
```json
{
  "route": "/embed-service",
  "notify_policy": {
    "on_quota_exceeded": "condense",
    "condense_window": 300,
    "owner_only_override": true
  }
}
```

kevin: Telemetry concern: we must keep a small downsample of full traces for debugging and a higher-rate token-level sampling for trend analysis. Suggest: full-trace 1% + token/metric sampling 10%. Also add a new metric `notify.suppressed.count`.

incident-bot: incident-bot: created ticket INF-492: investigate tenant retry amplification and implement soft-fanout prototype. Assigned to @jonathan.

olivia: Next steps: jonathan implements routing API/condense logic; kevin implements sampling + metric; maya prototypes console toggle + copy. Goal: EOD mock for canary. Volunteers?

maya: I'll prototype the UI copy and a compact example card. Ping me for copy review.

jonathan: I'll take the backend routing changes and a simple feature flag to gate per-tenant policy.

kevin: sg. I'll add `notify.suppressed.count` and `notify.condensed.rate` to the per-route dashboard and wire sampling controls.

sarah: Can we add a short runbook blurb in the console: "If suppressed alerts > 50% and error rate < 0.5% then consider tenant throttling / contact tenant" — makes oncall decision faster.

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll open PRs for API + console mocks and link tickets. Will also add the runbook suggestion to the console page.

olivia: Thanks all — tagging this for a light sync in 30m if anyone wants to join the quick design/ops pairing.
